title: ConceptScope: Characterizing Dataset Bias via Disentangled Visual Concepts

bias_targets.methodology: Using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) trained on vision foundation models to disentangle and categorize visual concepts (e.g., backgrounds, co-occurring objects) into target, context, and bias types based on their semantic relevance and statistical co-occurrence with image class labels.

Evaluating the framework's ability to detect known biases on the CelebA dataset by identifying the spurious statistical correlation between the 'blond hair' target attribute and the 'female' demographic attribute.

Applying the ConceptScope framework to discover novel, unannotated biases in real-world datasets like ImageNet, such as identifying that images labeled 'bridegroom' are spuriously correlated with 'East Asian cultural' visual contexts.
